text:
maria: heads up — eval CI started flagging a big quality drop on the Llama2-7B-quant onboarding suite this morning. several benchmarks show ~7% winrate regression vs yesterday.

sam: link? which job?

maria: https://ci.redwood/infrun/py/eval/2234 — runner job 2234, job shows metric deltas on `winrate` and `mean_accuracy`. first failing around 2034564300.

triage-bot: CI job 2234 failed: 12/120 tests failed, primary metric deviation > 5%. artifacts: s3://redwood-evals/artifacts/2234/logs.txt

ben: curious if this is a model change or harness metric change. any recent merges touching metric normalization or scorer weights?

carmen: i pulled the artifacts, ran the small reproducer locally with the same seed and config. failure looks consistent. snippet from eval logs:```
2026-03-20T09:12:03Z INFO metric: winrate=0.432 (baseline 0.509)
2026-03-20T09:12:03Z INFO metric: mean_accuracy=0.713 (baseline 0.758)
```

elaine: there was a PR merged this morning to standardize metric scaling across tasks — #4216 — it adjusted per-task normalization factors and clipped extreme values. landed at 2034540000. could be the culprit.

sam: can we bisect between yesterday's green and this morning? what's the last green commit?

maria: last green main at 2034539800. first bad at 2034541200. range small — looks like that PR landed between.

ben: quick grep shows the normalization change in `eval/metrics/normalize.py` around `normalize_scores(task, weights)`, they added a log-scale transform for low-variance tasks.

carmen: i ran the eval toggling that transform off locally — results back to expected. so it's likely the normalization transform is shifting thresholds for our winrate aggregator.

maria: okay, reproduce = yes. two options: revert the transform in prod eval harness, or adjust per-task weights to compensate.

ana-prod: tagging @ana-prod — this impacts onboarding door for the new quant model, we should avoid releasing until resolved.

ana-prod: agreed hold rollout. we have a canary in staging but not shipping yet.

sam: maria, can you do a git bisect to find the exact commit? will need hash for the rollback PR.

maria: running bisect now.

ops-bot: deploy pipeline queued for branch `main` — status: queued.

maria: bisect found culprit: commit 5fc9a2e (PR #4216) — normalize: add_log_scale_transform.

ben: thanks. is the transform mathematically correct but failing our old metric semantics? maybe we should add a feature flag behind harness config.

carmen: agreed — short-term revert or feature-flagging in harness config so we keep new behavior for downstream experiments but not for onboarding gating. i can open a revert PR for the harness config tomorrow morning.

elaine: can we hotfix by updating the eval config in S3 (the canonical harness config) to set `metric_normalization: legacy` for onboarding suites? no code change, just config swap.

maria: good idea — less blast radius. i can patch the config now and re-run the CI. command:```
aws s3 cp s3://redwood-eval-configs/onboard.yaml s3://redwood-eval-configs/onboard.yaml.bak && sed 's/normalize: log/normalize: legacy/' onboard.yaml | aws s3 cp - s3://redwood-eval-configs/onboard.yaml
```

ops-bot: permission check OK for maria.

maria: patched config and triggered rerun (job 2236).

triage-bot: CI job 2236 started.

carmen: also adding a unit test to catch metric-shift regressions — will include a small representative prompt set and assert baseline winrate within tolerance.

sam: good. ops, hold any scheduled canary promotions until we have green. tagging @ana-prod for visibility.

ana-prod: acknowledged. hold in place.

triage-bot: CI job 2236 passed: 120/120 tests, primary metric within tolerance. delta: winrate=0.501 (baseline 0.509).

maria: patch confirmed. opening PR to add `normalization_mode` flag and a note in the deploy checklist. link: https://git.redwood/pr/4320

ben: let's not drop the log-scale change entirely — it might be better for low-variance tasks long-term. but then we need a migration plan and updated baselines.

elaine: agreed, adding a task to the backlog: evaluate log-scale normalization across evaluation suites and update baselines if we flip it. assigned to ben + c/p.

sam: next steps: 1) merge config hotfix (maria) 2) add unit test (carmen) 3) feature-flag PR for metric normalization (maria/ben) 4) backlog evaluation (ben, elaine). keep this thread updated.

maria: hotfix merged and deployed, can close triage when release hold lifted.

ana-prod: release hold lifted pending docs update.

maria: closing — root cause = normalization transform in PR #4216, mitigated by config hotfix and added tests. will track follow-up in backlog ticket TRELL-88. :white_check_mark:
